sources.relevance: Upstream explains the importance of inlining and branch behavior for small inputs; notes alignment checking can be detrimental on x86.
Author explains how variable input lengths increase the cost of branch misprediction.

local_implication: Both old and new callbacks already use the upstream inline policy and match stock baseline assembly. Adding length specializations must be assessed with random-length measurements and the complete official CLI sweep; these sources do not establish a new speedup.
